entry.title: Cloudflare Hosting and Richer Feedback Reports
entry.summary: Treease moved web delivery onto Cloudflare, tightened graph render ownership, and made feedback reports more useful with optional contact details and file uploads.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Hosting and stability
paragraphs: Treease is now delivered through Cloudflare, with deployment hardening and graph render ownership fixes that reduce stale or incorrectly claimed render jobs during startup and refreshes.
Site disclosures were also updated to better match the new production setup and advertising requirements.

sections.heading: Feedback reports
paragraphs: Feedback reports can now include an optional contact email and uploaded files, making it easier to send actionable bug reports and follow up when needed.

entry.title: Clearer Usage and Subscription Management
entry.summary: Account usage is easier to understand, anonymous usage now appears in the account menu, and subscription changes are handled more reliably end to end.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Usage visibility
paragraphs: The account menu now shows anonymous usage, and local usage counts are deduplicated so activity totals stay more accurate.
Client-side and account-level usage tracking now line up more consistently when you switch between anonymous and signed-in use.

sections.heading: Billing reliability
paragraphs: Subscription plan changes now follow a more unified flow, and subscription status normalization is more robust across billing events.

entry.title: Feedback, Changelog, and Discoverability
entry.summary: Treease added an in-app feedback dialog and a generated changelog page, while improving search discoverability and graph startup reliability.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Stay informed and send feedback
paragraphs: Treease now includes a built-in feedback dialog for reporting issues or sharing ideas without leaving the app.
A generated changelog page is now available so product updates are easier to review in one place.

sections.heading: Search and startup improvements
paragraphs: Search discoverability was improved for both traditional SEO and newer AI-driven discovery surfaces.
Graph render ownership is preserved more reliably across runtime startup, reducing cases where the graph could fail to settle into the correct render state.

entry.title: Smoother Large Graph Rendering
entry.summary: Viewport virtualization and redraw trimming make large graphs faster to navigate, while table layout, request backoff, and cross-origin access are more stable.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Performance
paragraphs: Large graphs now render through viewport virtualization, so Treease does less work for off-screen content and feels faster while panning and exploring.
Unnecessary redraws along viewport edges were also removed to cut down on visual churn and extra render cost.

sections.heading: Reliability
paragraphs: Streaming table layouts are more stable, usage requests now back off after rate limits instead of hammering the server, and server CORS handling supports multiple allowed origins more cleanly.

entry.title: Workers Rollout and Metering Cleanup
entry.summary: Treease moved its server and asset delivery onto Cloudflare Workers, unified usage metering, improved billing webhook safety, and fixed streaming graph ownership issues.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Cloudflare rollout
paragraphs: Treease server deployment and web asset delivery now run on Cloudflare Workers, including the production domain routing needed for the new setup.
The move also came with graph ownership fixes for streaming updates, helping parent relationships stay correct while documents update incrementally.

sections.heading: Account and billing changes
paragraphs: Usage metering is now unified across client and signed-in account activity, making totals more consistent.
Subscription webhooks are idempotent, which reduces the chance of duplicate billing-side changes, and anonymous sign-in was removed in favor of a cleaner account model.

entry.title: Anonymous Accounts, Sharing, and Editor Polish
entry.summary: Treease improved anonymous account handling, strengthened share-link restore behavior, polished homepage and editor UI, and added a recursive compact operator for nested data cleanup.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Accounts and usage
paragraphs: Anonymous usage identity is preserved more reliably, anonymous account details and usage summaries are clearer, and login flows recover more gracefully across OAuth and standalone sign-in paths.
Postpaid usage gating was added, the account menu loads through a more unified path, and account-related icons and navigation affordances were cleaned up.

sections.heading: Sharing and interface polish
paragraphs: Shared links now restore graph focus and editor selection more reliably, even when the graph runtime is still starting up.

The editor keeps graph selection through hover changes, homepage demo playback was improved, semantic text colors were unified, workspace-only commands were removed from the command panel, and Treease branding in the top bar and home link was refreshed.

sections.heading: New compact behavior
paragraphs: A new recursive compact operator can compact nested structures in one pass, making it easier to clean up deeply nested data.

entry.title: Pricing, Navigation, and Desktop Actions
entry.summary: Checkout now respects login state, account navigation is easier to use, desktop file actions moved into menus, and Treease added AI credential routing plus prerendered CLI graph pages.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Account and billing flow
paragraphs: Pricing checkout now behaves correctly for signed-in and signed-out users, and account navigation was reorganized to make common destinations easier to reach.
Treease also added AI credential routing support for account-driven AI features.

sections.heading: Desktop and delivery
paragraphs: Desktop file actions were moved into the app menu for a cleaner workspace surface.
CLI graph pages can now be prerendered, improving how those pages load and ship on the web.

entry.title: Faster Trace Imports and Desktop Hosting
entry.summary: Streamed trace imports are faster, and the desktop app gained workspace hosting support.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease now imports streamed traces more efficiently, reducing waiting time on large trace inputs.
The desktop app also gained workspace hosting support, expanding how local workspaces can be opened and managed.

entry.title: Sharing, Sign-In, and Pricing Flow Update
entry.summary: Treease shipped a broader pass across auth, sharing, analytics-backed product flows, and pricing.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease updated core account, sharing, and pricing flows together so access and upgrade paths feel more coherent across the product.

entry.title: More Precise Structural Compare Results
entry.summary: Structural compare results now point to explicit byte spans, making diffs easier to locate and review.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease now uses structured compare diffs with explicit byte spans, so compare results can point to the exact source ranges that changed.

entry.title: More Reliable Graph Startup and Resize
entry.summary: Graph readiness is more stable, and workspace resizing now stays in sync more consistently.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Graph rendering now reaches a ready state more consistently, and workspace resize behavior stays synchronized more reliably during layout changes.

entry.title: Standalone API Service
entry.summary: Treease now includes a standalone API service for external integrations and hosted workflows.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: A standalone API service is now available, opening a cleaner path for integrations and server-backed Treease workflows.

entry.title: Cleaner Initial Example Loading
entry.summary: The initial example now goes through the full editing pipeline, so first-load behavior matches regular editing more closely.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: The first example document now loads through the same full edit and language-services path as normal editing, which makes initial behavior more consistent.

entry.title: URL-Driven Presets and Better Viewer Sync
entry.summary: Treease added URL-backed editor presets and reusable tutorial pages, while improving graph search, import progress, viewer mounting, drag guidance, and CLI graph rendering.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: URL setup and tutorials
paragraphs: Treease can now initialize editor presets from the URL and supports reusable tutorial pages, making it easier to share preloaded examples and guided workflows.
The editor also gained split-collapse animations and a graph canvas drag hint to make the interface easier to learn.

sections.heading: Editing and graph fixes
paragraphs: Graph search can now reveal table cells by anchor, column navigators reset correctly after full replacements, and empty containers render more sensibly as scalar cells when needed.

Blank input now clears the document, import progress messaging is clearer at the finish line, viewer panes stay mounted across mode switches, and CLI graph output handles missing and scalar cases more cleanly.

entry.title: CLI Progress and Version Visibility
entry.summary: The CLI now shows its version in help output and reports asset download progress.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease CLI help now includes the current version, and asset downloads report visible progress so long-running setup steps are easier to track.

entry.title: More Reliable Web Startup
entry.summary: Web runtime readiness was stabilized to reduce flaky startup behavior.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease startup is more reliable thanks to improved runtime readiness handling, reducing flaky load behavior.

entry.title: Column Navigator Editing Refresh
entry.summary: Column Navigators received a layout and editing overhaul, with better toolbar polish, safer cell editing rules, cleaner minimap rendering, and fixes for JSON formatting and graph edges.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Workspace layout and editing
paragraphs: The column navigator layout and editing flow were refined, including command and toolbar UI updates, simpler split-handle presentation, and safer behavior for missing graph cells.
Editing is now disabled where cells are genuinely missing, and table edit paths inside column navigators are handled more reliably.

sections.heading: Rendering and formatting fixes
paragraphs: Minimap borders now render more consistently, graph edge convergence was fixed, and nest-aware JSON formatting behaves more predictably.

entry.title: CLI Parsing and Version Support Improvements
entry.summary: The CLI improved version support, parsing reliability, null-input behavior, and command surface, while example switching keeps its highlight state more reliably.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: CLI improvements
paragraphs: CLI version handling and graph relayout behavior were improved, parsing regressions were fixed, and null input semantics are more consistent.
The examples doctor command was removed, simplifying the CLI surface.

sections.heading: Editor polish
paragraphs: Switching between language examples now preserves the active highlight more reliably.

entry.title: NDJSON Import, Linked Scrolling, and CLI Upgrades
entry.summary: Treease added JSONL and NDJSON import support, a scroll-and-reveal sync toggle, a web graph CLI route, and a more discoverable CLI, while fixing YAML parsing, blank-input analysis, compact output formatting, nested expansion, and several render races.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: New capabilities
paragraphs: Treease now supports JSONL and NDJSON import, re-enabled nested JSON expansion, and added a toggle to keep scrolling and reveal behavior linked only when you want it.
The CLI gained a web graph route plus a more agent-friendly command surface with structured errors and discovery commands.

sections.heading: Fixes and polish
paragraphs: Blank text now continues through analysis instead of short-circuiting, YAML block sequence parsing was restored after a regression, and compact scalar output no longer adds an extra trailing newline.
Several race conditions were fixed across full-edit intake, graph render flushing, and hover overflow handling.

entry.title: Initial Release
entry.summary: Treease launched its first public release as a structured-text graph editor.
entry.author: Treease Team

sections.heading: Highlights
paragraphs: Treease made its first public debut, introducing its foundation for structured-text editing and graph-based exploration.
